definitions.explanation: The act of becoming a member of an organization, signing up for a service, or enrolling in an insurance plan.

examples.japanese: {保険|ほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する。
{組合|くみあい}への{加入|かにゅう}は{任意|にんい}です。
{新|あたら}しいサービスに{加入|かにゅう}したいのですが、{手続|てつづ}きはどうすればいいですか。
examples.english: I'd like to subscribe to the new service — how do I go about the procedure?

notes:
Commonly used with に to indicate what one is joining. Frequently appears in contexts related to insurance, organizations, and services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{保険|ほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する (sign up for insurance)
・{組合|くみあい}に{加入|かにゅう}する (join a union)
・{加入|かにゅう}{者|しゃ} (subscriber, member)
・{加入|かにゅう}{手続|てつづ}き (enrollment procedure)
・{加入|かにゅう}{条件|じょうけん} (enrollment requirements)
